newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of Asia Securities suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Asia Securities suspended.

text.p: Trading in the shares of property and investment concern Asia Securities International Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Tuesday.
Asia Securities shares fell HK$0.07 to end on Monday at HK$1.92 per share with 803,000 shares traded.
Asia Securities engages in property investment and development, investment holding, underwriting and securities trading. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
